capabilities: Apply shape presets to Canvas cards via right-click menu or command palette
Set one shape across multiple selected cards
Add standard flowchart symbols for programming-logic diagrams
Adjust padding between text and the card edge in settings
extras: Shapes are stored in the plugin's own data file, not the .canvas file, so uninstalling the plugin loses the shapes; the README documents this trade-off plus clipped shapes having no border.
intentEvidence: Give Canvas cards a shape — from basic geometry to the symbols used in flowcharts and programming-logic diagrams.
problem: Obsidian Canvas offers exactly one card shape, a rectangle, so users must fake diamonds, capsules and other diagram symbols with styled rectangles.

relations.evidence: designed to work alongside this one
Advanced Canvas also ships flowchart node styles.

summary: Shape presets for Obsidian Canvas cards, from basic geometry (star, cloud) to standard flowchart symbols (decision, terminator, database).
